17064-the-story-of-a-plush-bear.title: The Story Of A Plush Bear
17064-the-story-of-a-plush-bear.creator: Laura Lee Hope
17064-the-story-of-a-plush-bear.description: A book by Laura Lee Hope. Down swirled the white flakes, blowing this way and that. It was snowing furiously in North Pole Land, and even the immense workshop of Santa Claus was almost buried in white. It whistled down the chimneys, and blew the sparks about.

arxiv-2012-04186.title: Observation of di-structures in e + ​ e − → J / ψ ​ X e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrow{J}/\psi{\rm X} at center-of-mass energies around 3.773 GeV
arxiv-2012-04186.creator: M. Ablikim 1 , M. N. Achasov 10,e , P. Adlarson 63 , S. Ahmed 15 , M. Albrecht 4 , A. Amoroso 62A,62C , Q. An 59,47 , Anita 21 , Y. Bai 46 , O. Bakina 28 , R. Baldini Ferroli 23A , I. Balossino 24A , Y. Ban 37,m , K. Begzsuren 26 , J. V. Bennett 5 , N. Berger 27 , M. Bertani 23A , D. Bettoni 24A , F
arxiv-2012-04186.description: Abstract We report a measurement of the observed cross sections of the inclusive J / ψ J/\psi production in e + ​ e − → J / ψ ​ X e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrow{J}/\psi{\rm X} based on 3.21 fb -1 of data accumulated at energies from 3.645 to 3.891 GeV with the BESIII detector operated at the BEPCII collider.

arxiv-2307-03887.title: Improving Prototypical Visual Explanations with Reward Reweighing, Reselection, and Retraining
arxiv-2307-03887.creator: Aaron J. Li, Robin Netzorg, Zhihan Cheng, Zhuoqin Zhang, Bin Yu
arxiv-2307-03887.description: Abstract In recent years, work has gone into developing deep interpretable methods for image classification that clearly attributes a model’s output to specific features of the data. One such of these methods is the prototypical part network (ProtoPNet), which attempts to classify images based on meaningful parts of the input.

arxiv-2403-06304.title: Hybrid-order topology in unconventional magnets of Eu-based Zintl compounds with surface-dependent quantum geometry
arxiv-2403-06304.creator: Yufei Zhao, Yiyang Jiang, Hyeonhu Bae, Kamal Das, Yongkang Li, Chao-Xing Liu, Binghai Yan
arxiv-2403-06304.description: Abstract The exploration of magnetic topological insulators is instrumental in exploring axion electrodynamics and intriguing transport phenomena, such as the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Here, we report that a family of magnetic compounds Eu 2n+1 In 2 (As,Sb) 2n+2 ( n = 0 , 1 , 2 n=0,1,2 ) exhibit both gapless Dirac surface states and chiral hinge modes.

arxiv-2411-17563.description: Abstract . We obtain Riesz transform bounds and characterise operator-adapted Hardy spaces to solve boundary value problems for singular Schrödinger equations − div ( A ∇ u ) + a V u = 0 -\textup{div}(A\nabla u)+aVu=0 in the upper half-space ℝ + 1 + n \mathbb{R}^{1+n}_{+} with boundary dimension n ≥ 3 n\geq 3 .

arxiv-2505-01984.title: Lifelong Whole Slide Image Analysis: Online Vision-Language Adaptation and Past-to-Present Gradient Distillation
arxiv-2505-01984.creator: DOANH C. BUI, HOAI LUAN PHAM, VU TRUNG DUONG LE, TUAN HAI VU, VAN DUY TRAN, KHANG NGUYEN, YASUHIKO NAKASHIMA
arxiv-2505-01984.description: Abstract Whole Slide Images (WSIs) play a crucial role in accurate cancer diagnosis and prognosis, as they provide tissue details at the cellular level. However, the rapid growth of computational tasks involving WSIs poses significant challenges. Given that WSIs are gigapixels in size, they present difficulties in terms of storage, processing, and model training.

arxiv-2508-07312.title: MobileViCLIP: An Efficient Video-Text Model for Mobile Devices
arxiv-2508-07312.creator: Min Yang, Zihan Jia, Zhilin Dai, Sheng Guo, Limin Wang
arxiv-2508-07312.description: Abstract Efficient lightweight neural networks are with increasing attention due to their faster reasoning speed and easier deployment on mobile devices. However, existing video pre-trained models still focus on the common ViT architecture with high latency, and few works attempt to build efficient architecture on mobile devices.

arxiv-2510-25166.title: A Study on Inference Latency for Vision Transformers on Mobile Devices
arxiv-2510-25166.creator: Zhuojin Li, Marco Paolieri, Leana Golubchik
arxiv-2510-25166.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zhuojin Li, Marco Paolieri, Leana Golubchik. Given the significant advances in machine learning techniques on mobile devices, particularly in the domain of computer vision, in this work we quantitatively study the performance characteristics of 190 real-world vision transformers (ViTs) on mobile devices. Through a comparison with 102 real-world convolutional neural networks (CNNs), we provide insights into the factors that influence the latency of ViT architectures on mobile devices.

pmc-10571500.title: Association of genetic variations in FoxP3 gene with Graves' disease in a Southwest Chinese Han population
pmc-10571500.creator: Guiqin Tan, Guangbing Zheng, Jiang Li, Yingping Zhu, Zhongzhi Liang, Hua Li, Hongsong Yu, Xin Wang
pmc-10571500.description: BackgroundGraves' disease (GD) is a T cell‐mediated organ‐specific autoimmune disease. Forkhead box P3 (FoxP3) is an excellent marker for the induction and development of regulatory T cells (Tregs). Recent studies showed that single‐nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) in the FoxP3 gene were associated with the increased susceptibility to several autoimmune diseases.

pmc-11470938.title: Bilateral interactions of optic-flow sensitive neurons coordinate course control in flies
pmc-11470938.creator: Victoria O Pokusaeva, Roshan Satapathy, Olga Symonova, Maximilian Joesch
pmc-11470938.description: Animals rely on compensatory actions to maintain stability and navigate their environment efficiently. These actions depend on global visual motion cues known as optic-flow. While the optomotor response has been the traditional focus for studying optic-flow compensation in insects, its simplicity has been insufficient to determine the role of the intricate optic-flow processing network involved in visual course control.

pmc-11503867.title: Genome Survey of Male Rana dybowskii to Further Understand the Sex Determination Mechanism
pmc-11503867.creator: Yuan Xu, Hanyu Liu, Xinshuai Jiang, Xinning Zhang, Jiayu Liu, Yaguang Tian, Xiujuan Bai, Shiquan Cui, Shengwei Di
pmc-11503867.description: Simple SummaryTo obtain more female individuals in the breeding population of R. dybowskii, it is important to explore the sex determination mechanism based on whole genome analysis. In this study, we analyzed the genome survey of male individuals of R. dybowskii using next-generation sequencing technology. The estimated genome size of R. dybowskii was approximately 3585.05 M.

pmc-11656950.title: Neurobehavioral disorders among children born to mothers exposed to illicit substances during pregnancy
pmc-11656950.creator: Vincent Chin-Hung Chen, Charles Tzu-Chi Lee, Shu-I. Wu, Michael Gossop
pmc-11656950.description: BackgroundExposure to illicit substances during pregnancy may have long-term impacts on children’s neurodevelopment. This study explores subsequent risks for intellectual disability, autistic disorders, and attention deficit and hyperactivity disorders in children born to mothers exposed to illicit substances before or during pregnancy.

pmc-13113279.title: The Role of Endometrial Microbiota in the Pathogenesis of Chronic Endometritis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-13113279.creator: Angela Vidal, Anaïs Y. Kilian, Vithusha Vinayahalingam, Branislav Zagrapan, Janna Pape, Tanya Karrer, Michael von Wolff
pmc-13113279.description: Background: Chronic endometritis (CE) is a subtle, often asymptomatic endometrial inflammation marked by CD138+ plasma cell infiltration and linked to recurrent implantation failure (RIF), recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL), and unexplained infertility. Emerging evidence implicates endometrial microbiome dysbiosis in CE. Objective: To systematically review and conduct meta-analysis on the association between CE and endometrial microbiome alterations and their reproductive implications.

pmc-13675447.title: Management of extravasations of enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab: a case report and mini review of the current literature
pmc-13675447.creator: Hendrik Dinkel, Konstantin E. Seifert, Martin Bögemann, Andres J. Schrader, Katrin Schlack
pmc-13675447.description: Following the EV-302/KEYNOTE-A39 study, the combination therapy of enfortumab vedotin and pembrolizumab (EV-P) has been established as a new first-line treatment for metastatic urothelial carcinoma. With increasing use, the documentation and publication of unexpected side effects and complications are essential to systematize procedures.

uslaw-usc-t18-s3771.title: 18 U.S.C. § 3771 — Crime victims’ rights
uslaw-usc-t18-s3771.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s3771.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part II (Criminal Procedure); Chapter 237 (Crime Victims’ Rights). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Rights of Crime Victims.— A crime victim has the following rights: (1) The right to be reasonably protected from the accused. (2) The right to reasonable, accurate, and timely notice of any public court proceeding, or any parole.
